description: This file defines the Perl module 'Mail::Address' which handles parsing and formatting email address strings, including extracting names, handling comments, and producing properly formatted address strings.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: Perl class representing an email address, providing methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting parts of an email address.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Mail::Address module.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Attempts to extract a person's name from a comment string, cleaning up various formats and casing.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Tokenizes an input string into meaningful address components, handling parentheses, brackets, quotes, and special delimiters.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Finds the next significant token in a list of tokens based on delimiters.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Creates a new Mail::Address object from address components if any are present.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Mail::Address object with specified components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string or list of strings into a list of Mail::Address objects.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Accessor for the phrase (personal name part) of the address.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Accessor for the email address part.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Accessor for the comment part of the address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Generic getter/setter for phrase, address, or comment components.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats one or more addresses into a string suitable for display or email headers.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the person's name from the address components, attempting different parsing strategies.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the email address, if present.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the username part of the email address.
